title: Anybody keep seeing an almost infinite version of the mall world? I do.
content: Okay so my last experience with the infinite form of the mall world was just last night. The entrance method I used and is usable with my dream world is surviving a "wakeup protocol" consisting of repeated loud alarms without waking up. This time, it took the form of my school and came after a couple weird/usual fever scenes as an intermission between method and summoning. I completed the method inside the gym on floor 1 during the current shuffle. GOD it was loud. Here's how my experience went. A new entry thing appeared on Floor 2 the following dream day (I know this because one of the intermission scenes showed me at home.) and I used it. Floor 3 of the new stuff took the form of a usual additional floor of a school. I only saw the intersection area before I used the entry thing again and went up to Floor 4, where the mall began and the school stopped. There were a few nice shops here and a big food court. Never went up to Floor 5 but saw the school style back in use telling me some floors can be tricks. That's where my experience stopped because I woke up. My other experiences have been seeing some sort of attached tower in the lucid mall space through entering a playground-looking structure, remembering a couple seconds of some sort of night area where there was incredibly dark lighting and a peaceful vibe. Other than that, nothing much that is confirmed to be the infinite mall or things attached yet.
